1. **Dynamic Sampling** - The concept of dynamically adjusting the sampling rate based on real-time performance and workload.
2. **Auto Scaling** - The ability of the model to automatically scale up or down based on the workload.
3. **Model Optimization** - The ability of the model to adapt to changes in workload and workload complexity, which includes both model parameters and the model architecture.
